images.after: The rules that get accounts closed
images.title: Rules to check before you build
images.alt: Checklist of Amazon Associates policy rules covering disclosure, prices, reviews, offline use, email, link clarity and incentives.
images.caption: Amazon can end your account, so read the full program policies first.

items: State "As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases"
Show prices or stock only if Amazon serves them
Don't copy Amazon reviews or star ratings unless via the API
No Amazon links in printed material, ebooks or mailings
Email, SMS and DM links only to people who opted in
Make it clear the reader is going to Amazon; no cloaking
No cash back, discounts or rewards for buying through you

images.note: Check the current Associates Program Policies for the exact wording
